parameters.content:
# W5: Self-Correcting Research Engine v2

## USES N8N DATA TABLES + LOCAL FILES

This workflow:
- Saves to **research_data** table
- Writes .md file to **C:/dev/production_line/research/**

## Output Files
- research_{id}.md - Formatted research document

## SETUP REQUIRED
Create Data Table 'research_data' with columns:
- research_id, topic_id, topic, depth, summary
- insights, statistics, sources (text/JSON)
- quality_score (number), status (text)

## Cost: Light ~$0.04 | Medium ~$0.08 | Deep ~$0.15

values.content:
You are a research synthesizer. Analyze the research and extract structured data.

Output ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "summary": "500 word comprehensive summary",
  "insights": [{"text": "...", "importance": 1-10, "category": "actionable|warning|trend|fact"}],
  "quotes": [{"text": "quote", "author": "name", "source": "url"}],
  "statistics": [{"stat": "number", "source": "name", "year": 2024}],
  "sources": [{"title": "...", "url": "...", "type": "article|study|report"}],
  "key_themes": ["theme1", "theme2"]
}
